headline: Domestic growth momentum & margin expansion to drive growth

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : ELGI Equipment’s reported healthy consolidated revenue growth of 17.2% YoY to ₹1,134.3 crore in Q2FY27 vs ₹968.0 crore in Q2FY26.
Operating EBITDA increased 28.1% YoY to ₹183.5 crore from ₹143.3 crore, with operating EBITDA margin expanding 138 bps YoY to 16.2% from 14.8%, indicating improved operating profitability.
Air Compressor business, which contributed approximately 92% of total revenue increased 18.0% YoY to ₹1,044.7 crore from ₹885.5 crore, Automotive Equipment revenue grew 8.3% YoY to ₹89.7 crore.

Investment Rationale: • Strong domestic growth outlook supported by GTM initiatives and Vayu expansion : ELGi Equipment’s is witnessing improving domestic demand momentum, supported by enhanced customer penetration, improved demand conversion and benefits from its go-to-market (GTM) strategy implemented over the past 2.5 years.
valuation: Rating and Target Price : We expect Revenue and PAT to grow at 13.5% and 19% CAGR over FY26-FY28E.
We recommend BUY on Elgi Equipments with a target price of ₹675 per share (based on 35 x FY28E EPS).
